The leaders of the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|rebellion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] had their headquarters in a '''bunker''' near the [[unfinished colossus]] of [[Darth Vowrawn]]. It was assaulted by [[Cipher Nine]] around [[3643 BBY]].
